description: The LIASTRA Institute is the organization behind the project. Theme: Cognitionem ad Innovationem, from knowledge to innovation. The Aerospace Innovation Center (AIC) is part of the LIASTRA Institute, with the ICBS Laboratory. Analog missions are immersive experiments designed to simulate real conditions of space missions, with the aim of training analog astronauts and promoting scientific education; this initiative combines science, technology and simulation to prepare the next generation.
